about.title: About PixGo
about.p1: PixGo is an open platform providing technical tools so that enthusiast creators can store, organize, and share audiovisual content. We are not a studio or a production company — we are the infrastructure others use to preserve and distribute what they create or catalog.
about.p2: Born from the wish to keep a record of content that has fallen into the public domain, whose copyright has expired, or that has become hard to find elsewhere. We believe part of the cultural value of these works is lost when they become inaccessible, and we built this platform to give enthusiasts the tools to prevent that.
about.p3: Maintaining servers, storage, and distribution has real, ongoing costs. Subscriptions available on the platform grant access to additional technical resources — higher playback quality, extra profiles, more downloads — and the funds collected are used exclusively to keep the service running. We do not sell content: creators remain solely responsible for what they publish.
about.p4: We take copyright protection and good platform use seriously. We maintain review processes and a direct channel for complaints, and act with priority on any substantiated report.
